title: Getting to know a new neighbour
objectives: Introduce yourself as a new neighbour
Ask for a practical tip about the building
Ask how to join the building group

courseTemplate.setting: The new resident is in 5B. Rubbish goes out on Tuesday evenings. There is a building group chat.

roles.learner: A person who just moved into apartment 5B

courseTemplate.openingLine: Hi there! I haven't seen you around before.

targetPatterns.pattern: Hi, I'm Chen. I've just moved into apartment 5B.
targetPatterns.example: Hi, I'm Chen. I've just moved into apartment 5B.

targetPatterns.pattern: Thanks. When should I put the rubbish out?
targetPatterns.example: Thanks. When should I put the rubbish out?

targetPatterns.pattern: Is there a building group chat I could join?
targetPatterns.example: Is there a building group chat I could join?

targetPatterns.pattern: Is there a neighborhood group chat or app?
targetPatterns.example: Is there a neighborhood group chat or app?
targetPatterns.translation: 社区有群聊或 App 吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: How can I join the community garden?
targetPatterns.example: How can I join the community garden?

targetPatterns.pattern: Are new volunteers welcome at the food bank?
targetPatterns.example: Are new volunteers welcome at the food bank?
targetPatterns.translation: 食物银行欢迎新志愿者吗？

targetPatterns.pattern: What time is the block party on Saturday?
targetPatterns.example: What time is the block party on Saturday?
targetPatterns.translation: 周六的街区派对几点开始？

targetPatterns.pattern: I'd like to introduce myself — I just moved in next door.
targetPatterns.example: I'd like to introduce myself — I just moved in next door.
targetPatterns.translation: 自我介绍一下，我刚搬来隔壁。

targetPatterns.pattern: Is there a residents' association I can join?
targetPatterns.example: Is there a residents' association I can join?

targetPatterns.pattern: Where do people usually meet up around here?
targetPatterns.example: Where do people usually meet up around here?
targetPatterns.translation: 这一带大家一般去哪聚？

targetPatterns.pattern: Could I help set up for the event?
targetPatterns.example: Could I help set up for the event?

stages.title: Introduce yourself as a new neighbour
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Hi there! I haven't seen you around before.”
successCriteria: The learner can introduce yourself as a new neighbour in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Hi, I'm Chen. I've …”

stages.title: Ask for a practical tip about the building
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Welcome! Let me know if you have questions about the building.”
successCriteria: The learner can ask for a practical tip about the building in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Thanks. When should I …”

stages.title: Ask how to join the building group
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Tuesday evenings. It's a good idea to check notices in the hall too.”
successCriteria: The learner can ask how to join the building group in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Is there a building …”
